messages:
Sarah (CS): Hey team — kicking off VegaCo onboarding. Quick goal: get prod-ready inference calls with Redwood hosted API by day 10, and a handoff doc for their infra team by day 30.
Mike S.: +1. Do we have stakeholder contacts and API keys from Vega yet?
Sarah (CS): Received contacts — Jenna (platform), Omar (security) and Luis (product). API keys: staging keys provided, prod provisioning needs SSO + contract sign-off.
Raj Patel: On eng side, we need their sample payloads and peak qps expectations. Can someone share typical prompt lengths?
Alex Chen: I asked Vega for a sample CSV of 100 recent requests; they said 10–20 tokens avg but spikes up to 1k for long docs. We'll need to plan batching and KV cache.
Sarah (CS): Success criteria (proposed): 1) End-to-end generate latency under 400ms p95 for their 90% workload on Dedicated small pool; 2) Integration tests passing with redwood-sdk; 3) Runbook + rollback steps delivered. Thoughts?
Mike S.: Those are good. Add training for their ops (30–45m session) and a checklist for renewal signals at 60 days.
Raj Patel: Noted on latency. I'll scope a small benchmark template. Also flagging potential renewal risk: Vega's usage is seasonal — forecasting mismatch could cause capacity debt. Add auto-burst config.
Sarah (CS): Risk register entry: "Seasonal throughput mismatch" — mitigation: enable burst capacity + weekly usage sync for first 90 days.
OnboardBot: Reminder: Please complete the onboarding intake form: https://redwood.internal/onboard/forms/vega (due in 48h)
Alex Chen: For enablement, I'll draft a runbook skeleton. Putting checklist here:
```
- API key/prod provisioning steps
- Canary rollout config (traffic split example)
- Observable dashboards to monitor: latency, token count, errors
- Escalation contacts + SLO thresholds
```
Sarah (CS): Nice. Can we target the first integration demo on Tue (day 3)? Mike, you available to join?
Mike S.: I can do Tue 10am PT. I'll bring the integration checklist.
Raj Patel: I'll try to have a small benchmark script by then but might be day 4.
Sarah (CS): Action items assigned:
- Sarah: Confirm contract sign-off ETA with legal and request prod key provisioning (due day 2)
- Mike S.: Integration checklist + demo (due day 3)
- Alex: Runbook + training slides (due day 7)
- Raj: Benchmark template + burst config suggestion (due day 5)
- Vega (Jenna/Omar/Luis): provide sample payloads, SSO info, and compliance docs (due day 2)

Mike S.: Noted. I'll also add a quick prompt-preservation test to catch tokenization regressions.
Sarah (CS): Excellent. I'll schedule the recurring "onboard health" 30-min sync twice weekly for the first 4 weeks and invite all stakeholders. Any objections?
Alex Chen: No objections. Suggest we include a standing agenda: blockers, telemetry, rollout decision.
Raj Patel: Agreed. Also adding a line to the acceptance criteria: "No major regressions in quality as measured by their rubric (precision@k) after rollout."
Sarah (CS): Done — adding quality metric.
OnboardBot: New meeting created: VegaCo Onboarding — Tue 10:00 PT, 30m. Calendar invites sent.
Sarah (CS): Great work everyone. I'll post the onboarding doc link in this thread once the intake is complete. :handshake:
